claims.statement: Auto-archive guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES; GHES additionally requires enterprise owner enabling project automation policy. Documentation does not prove project workflow permission or native enablement.

Archiving removes items from active views while retaining custom fields and allowing archive-page viewing/restoration. This is distinct from issue closure, repository deletion and permanent project-item deletion.

Supported workflow filter subset is is(open/closed/merged/draft/issue/pr), reason(completed/reopened/not planned) and updated age comparisons. General project search qualifiers must not be assumed supported here.

updated examples use less-than today minus days/weeks/month, selecting older items, although parenthetical prose says last period. Preserve age-direction ambiguity rather than interpreting as recently updated items.

Issue/PR update events include creation, reopening, editing, commenting, labeling, assignee/milestone changes and transfer; project field changes also update item. Lack of code activity is not equivalent to updated timestamp inactivity.

Enabling automation archives existing matches as well as future matches, with possible delay for large batches. Activation has immediate historical-item impact; source does not specify an exact recurring schedule or latency guarantee.

Pinned project item_limit resolves to 50,000 across active and archived items. Archiving does not free that quota; permanent item deletion is separately destructive and not authorized by the limit guidance.

Settings procedure navigates Workflows, edits Auto-archive filters and Save and turn on workflow enables it. Saved configuration is not effective matching, completed archive or successful restoration evidence.
Links to archive management/automation are separate source evidence; no project settings changed, item archived/deleted, policy accepted, rights cleared or native rollout verified.
